name: guru-orchestrate-issue-dag
description: Explicitly coordinate a GitHub Issue dependency graph across Codex chats and worktrees, with bounded parallel execution, heartbeat supervision and live endpoint proof. Invoke by name for DAG, fan-out or fan-in orchestration. Discussing this Skill, drawing a graph or requesting a dry-run does not start execution. Single-Issue workflow stages retain their original owners.

entry_preconditions.evidence: The complete same-provider package and shared method, current native Codex capabilities and supported explicit child model/effort settings.
entry_preconditions.binding: This instruction-only invocation and the exact saved target project.
entry_preconditions.freshness: Read current provider files and tool contracts before preflight; verify native heartbeat readback before dispatch.

entry_preconditions.evidence: Current selected repository/Issues, live prerequisite and accepted scope facts, and actual human messages in the current coordinator conversation.
entry_preconditions.binding: One current run; endpoint and execution authorization remain dialogue-only.
entry_preconditions.freshness: Resolve before first child/heartbeat; recover original same-run human messages after context loss or changed scope.

entry_preconditions.evidence: Actual existing chat/Task/heartbeat ownership, pending creation results, Git/PR/check state and original-owner gate results.
entry_preconditions.binding: Each selected Issue and its exact existing or prospective child owner.
entry_preconditions.freshness: Inspect overlap before creation and refresh affected facts before continuation, merge, completion or settlement.

reentry.identity: The current coordinator conversation, exact repository/Issue selection and existing formal or pending child bindings.
reentry.freshness: Recover original human messages and current native/GitHub facts; preserve existing owners and refresh affected gates without repeating sufficient current delegation.
